title: The review record names the model that ran round 1 (haiku for #3005), not the one that ran round 2
why: Owner note on page item 832 (15:02 CST Nov 14, verbatim): "its not even wrong. message retrospective theres just a bug that needs patching here its transcript has it". Known so far (the lane of #3005 and the coordinator, relayed; triage read none): the posted record on #3005 (comment 6876422660, head 013e6d573d61) shows round 1 sonnet FAIL and round 2 sonnet PASS, while round 1's real reviewer was haiku. Triage's reading, not the owner's words: the record tool or the way the lane passes the model writes the wrong row. Unread: where the row comes from (the tool's default, the lane's flag, or the agent's reported model), and the transcript the owner points to, which triage does not have. Kin: step record-after-each-round (a lane account that round 1 reviewers ran haiku, the role model). Rule: reports-done-names-models. First act of a lane: get the retrospective session's transcript through the coordinator, find the bug, then red then green: a record row names the model the reviewer ran, and a mismatch is refused or flagged. A record check change: round 3 applies if a verdict moves. LANE STARTED 15:11 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 15:09): lane session_013NEJKzuQQPyWFCq35ZGEBK. The retrospective session is session_013NEJKz5AWFJhGvmCUoi6wQ (the consultant, per the coordinator); the coordinator asked it for the #3005 transcript. CORRECTION 15:12 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 15:11): the consultant is NOT the retrospective session; it holds only the owner's pasted "Draft retrospective", with no model-row source. The transcript is the #3005 lane's, session_013NEJL1FmGQvNLgjrnoxD7B; the coordinator asked it at 15:11. This corrects the line above that named the consultant. LANE QUESTION 15:12 CST Nov 14 (the lane, via triage as page writer; its code reads, unchecked by triage): the record tool prints whatever the lane types in `--round N:ROLE:MODEL:VERDICT` and checks rounds 2 and up against the model row; round 1 has no check (merge/merge.py:5046; round_arg line 4701; review_body line 4105). So #3005's "round 1 sonnet" may be a typed word, not the real model; the tool has no source for the model the agent really ran. Options: (a) check round 1 against the role row and refuse a mismatch; (b) a new `--ran-model` source from the agent's report, a mismatch flagged, a missing one reads unknown; (c) wait for the transcript before choosing. The lane recommends c. Triage's answer: c, the lane waits; nothing for the owner yet. The owner is asked only if the transcript leaves a pick between a and b. LANE ACCOUNT 15:14 CST Nov 14 (the #3005 lane session_013NEJL1FmGQvNLgjrnoxD7B, answered 15:12 via the coordinator; the cause is the lane's account, not the coordinator's; triage read none): the round 1 row's model is the `--round` flag it typed (`1:reviewer:sonnet:FAIL`, 05:12 CST), typed to satisfy "rounds must start at 1"; round 1's real reviewer ran haiku (agents/reviewer.md model: haiku). The tool's usage text (merge/merge.py line 36) says "MODEL must be sonnet on every record", yet #3400's records show a round 1 haiku accepted (REST). The build lane read the code: round 1's model is unchecked (the post-time check covers rounds 2 and up only). Open for the lane: why the usage text and accepted records differ, and what the tool can check. The lane's question on options a, b, c stays: wait, as answered. HANDED IN 16:11 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 16:11): #3425 handed in and given to runner 10: head 765da0f3ab3b, record 6884895895 (round 1 sonnet PASS, fix check de7cbd42310e PASS), lane lint 6884968625 PASS; the coordinator read them by REST (triage read none). A passing round ends review, so the coordinator's earlier "round 3 applies" in the lane brief was wrong. Record guard note (lane, relayed): usage text and decisions agent-model-cap and pr-review-record edited to match the code; the tool still cannot see what a reviewer ran.
